recipes.name: Spinach Puffs inspired by The Emperor's New Groove
instructions: Start by rinsing all of your spinach and removing all of the stems. Next, roughly chop the spinach into small bite-sized pieces, then finely chop dill and finely mince shallot. - 2 ½ cups spinach roughly chopped - 3 tbsp dill - 1 shallot finely minced

Heat a pan with olive oil over medium-high heat and add your finely minced shallots. Cook for about 2 minutes or until translucent and then add large cloves of crushed garlic. Sauté for about 30 seconds or until fragrant. - olive oil - 1 shallot finely minced - 3 cloves large garlic crushed

Add the spinach and a pinch of salt and cook down before adding the 3 Tbsp of dill. Sauté before adding some fresh pepper. Remove from heat and set aside. - 2 ½ cups spinach roughly chopped - salt to taste - 3 tbsp dill - pepper to taste

In a mixing bowl, combine full fat cream cheese with feta cheese and parmesan cheese. Add the cooked spinach mixture, finely chopped bacon, and egg yolk. Stir to combine. - 4 ounces full fat cream cheese - ½ cup feta cheese - 3 ounces parmesan grated - 1 eggs separated - 2 ½ cups spinach roughly chopped - 2 ½ slices bacon finely chopped

Liberally flour your work surface and place your puff pastry on top of the flour. Using a rolling pin, lightly roll out to take out the creases. Cut into 3-4 inch squares and place on a parchment lined baking sheet. - flour for dusting - 1 packet puff pastry

Add about 2 Tbsp of the mixture to each square of puff pastry. Beat one egg in a separate bowl and use that to brush two edges of the puff pastry. Crimp the egg washed sides together. Do this for all of your pastries and be sure to listen to ‘80s power ballads while doing it. - 1 eggs separated - 1 packet puff pastry

Place entire baking sheet in fridge for 10 minutes. Remove from the fridge and brush each pastry with an egg wash. Place in the oven for 20 minutes, rotating the baking sheet at 10 minutes. - 2 eggs separated
Remove from oven. Let cool on a wire rack. Serve and enjoy!
